mechanism_narrative: A lower current level of the federal funds rate compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for FEDFUNDS level is negative over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low-rate environments are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A current unemployment rate above 4.0% signals economic weakness, reducing corporate earnings expectations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The signal fails if UNRATE > 4.0 is associated with positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or if the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 280 and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) remains above 0.5%, the market perceives persistent inflation without adequate monetary policy response, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction signal fails if the Rank IC for the joint condition (CPIAUCSL>280 and FEDFUNDS>0.5) is negative over any 3-year rolling window, or if the 20-day returns in triggered instances are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle economic expansions, high housing starts (HOUST > 1800) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) signal that the economy is overheating, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The mechanism fails if the 20-day forward returns in late-cycle expansion periods with HOUST>1800 and UNRATE<4.0% are positive in more than 60% of cases, or if the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A current industrial production index above 105 signals robust manufacturing activity, boosting corporate earnings expectations and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The signal fails if INDPRO > 105 is associated with negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or if the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When employment growth (PAYEMS) exceeds 151,000 and the federal funds rate remains above 0.5%, the market anticipates persistent inflation and aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction signal fails if the Rank IC for the joint condition (PAYEMS>151000 and FEDFUNDS>0.5) is negative over any 3-year rolling window, or if the 20-day returns in triggered instances are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A current housing starts level below 1700 (thousands of units) signals weak residential construction, reducing consumer confidence and corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The signal fails if HOUST < 1700 is associated with positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or if the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles, a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 0.5%) combined with high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 285) signals aggressive policy to combat inflation, reducing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The mechanism fails if the 20-day forward returns in monetary tightening cycles with FEDFUNDS>0.5% and CPIAUCSL>285 are positive in more than 60% of cases, or if the Rank IC for the joint condition is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
